The engineered mesh upper is incredibly breathable, and the wider base provides a stable, confidence-inspiring platform for all foot types. A serious upgrade for long-distance daily training.

The leak-proof lid with carabiner clip attaches easily to your gym bag, and the 600ml capacity is perfect for full post-workout shakes. The agitator sphere ensures smooth, lump-free mixing every time.

accessory.material: 304-grade stainless steel body, BPA-free plastic lid
accessory.usage: Mixing protein shakes, pre-workout, BCAAs, and powdered supplements
accessory.durability: Stainless steel construction — rust-resistant, odour-proof, and scratch-resistant. Estimated 5+ year lifespan.

name: Amazon Basics Fabric Resistance Band Set – 3 Levels
description: Amazon Basics Fabric Resistance Bands are a premium set of 3 non-slip fabric loop bands — Light, Medium, and Heavy resistance levels. Unlike latex bands that roll and slide, these fabric bands stay in place during squats, glute bridges, lateral walks, and clamshells. Ideal for glute activation, physiotherapy, and home workouts. The comfortable, skin-friendly fabric is soft, durable, and sweat-resistant.

accessory.material: 65% Cotton, 35% Polyester with non-slip inner rubber layer
accessory.usage: Glute activation, squats, lunges, lateral walks, clamshells, physiotherapy rehabilitation
accessory.durability: Reinforced stitching on all bands. Fabric construction avoids the rolling and snapping issues of latex bands. Rated for 10,000+ repetitions.

name: GNC Pro Performance Neoprene Lifting Belt – Black
description: The GNC Pro Performance Lifting Belt provides crucial lumbar and abdominal support during heavy compound movements including squats, deadlifts, overhead presses, and rows. Made from 6mm thick neoprene with a firm inner core, it supports intra-abdominal pressure throughout the lift. The Velcro closure allows micro-adjustment for a precise fit across all waist sizes, and the wide back panel distributes pressure evenly.

accessory.material: 6mm Neoprene outer shell with firm compressed foam core
accessory.usage: Squats, deadlifts, overhead press, barbell rows, and all heavy compound barbell work
accessory.durability: Heavy-duty Velcro closure with double-stitched edges. Suitable for daily training with proper care. Average lifespan 2–3 years of consistent use.

name: GNC Pro Performance Wrist Wraps – Black/Red
description: GNC Pro Performance Wrist Wraps deliver targeted wrist support during heavy pressing, overhead, and Olympic lifting movements. Made from a cotton-elastic blend for durability and comfort. Sold as a pair — suitable for both men and women.

accessory.usage: Bench press, overhead press, clean & jerk, snatch, gymnastics, and any exercise placing high stress on wrists
accessory.durability: Reinforced stitching along edges and around thumb loop. Machine-washable. Estimated 6–12 months with daily heavy use.

name: MyProtein 5mm Neoprene Knee Sleeves – Black
description: MyProtein 5mm Neoprene Knee Sleeves are an essential accessory for any serious squatter. The 5mm neoprene provides warmth and compression to maintain joint health during heavy squats, lunges, and leg presses. Compression improves proprioception, reduces the risk of patella tracking issues, and may aid recovery between sessions. Sold as a pair and available in multiple sizes from XS to XXL.

accessory.material: 5mm thick neoprene rubber — industry-standard lifting competition thickness
accessory.usage: Squats, leg press, lunges, and any knee-dominant exercise requiring joint support and warmth
accessory.durability: Neoprene maintains compression and elasticity for 1–2 years of daily use. Hand wash only to preserve neoprene properties.

name: GNC Pro Performance 700ml Shaker Bottle – White
description: GNC Pro Performance Shaker Bottle is a durable, BPA-free 700ml shaker with a leak-proof flip-top lid and a built-in wire whisk ball for smooth, clump-free mixing. Dishwasher safe and gym-bag ready.

accessory.material: BPA-free food-grade HDPE plastic body with stainless steel whisk ball

description: MuscleBlaze Latex Resistance Loop Bands offer a progressive 5-level resistance system from 2kg to 40kg in a single affordable kit.
